Initial release of influencer-realtime-enrichment skill.

- Provides realtime creator and content data enrichment for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
- Supports freshness-critical details, latest content retrieval, and delta checks via explicit operationId mapping.
- Delivers matrix of available endpoints, required inputs, and output contract focused on key metric deltas and campaign impact.
- Includes detailed workflow, usage tooling, and environment configuration guidance.
- Built-in quota handling: clearly notifies users on quota exhaustion and guides them to obtain their own API key.
